desc: Report a problem never carries the paper notes' device code: with a code in the user folder (notes_code.txt, a test code), TTYD_REPORT_PROBLEM_TEST puts it in a line of the log's tail (not printed); the zip made in the launcher's About has that line with the code taken out ('<notes-code>'), and the code nowhere in it, nor in the log
log_must: ^\[report\] zip: papercut-report-test\.zip, \d+ files, \d+ bytes: system\.txt .* log\.txt
